# Dimension3D

> Professional FDM 3D printing service based in Barcelona, serving customers across Spain and Europe, with a maker network expanding to other cities.

## Services

- [Homepage](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/) — main site: file upload for a quote in under 1 hour, service overview, reviews, city coverage
- [3D printing service (international)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-service) — English landing page for customers outside Barcelona
- [3D printing Barcelona](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-barcelona) — local Barcelona service page: quote in 1h, delivery in 24–48h
- [3D printing for business](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-for-business-barcelona) — companies, engineering teams, short production runs, NDAs
- [Urgent / express 3D printing](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/urgent-3d-printing-barcelona) — priority queue, 24–48h and same-day delivery for genuine emergencies
- [Custom parts](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/custom-parts-barcelona) — parts from an STL/STEP file, a photograph, or measurements; no minimum order
- [Prototype printing](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/prototype-printing-barcelona) — functional prototypes for startups, engineers and design students
- [Replacement parts](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/replacement-parts-barcelona) — discontinued or broken plastic parts for appliances, furniture, vehicles

## Guides

- [How to choose a 3D printing service](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/how-to-choose-3d-printing-service-barcelona) — buyer's guide: what to ask, red flags, service-model comparison
- [3D printing materials guide](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-materials-guide) — PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, Nylon, CF composites with honest tradeoffs
- [How to prepare a file for 3D printing](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/how-to-prepare-file-for-3d-printing) — accepted formats, wall thickness, tolerances, supports, hole sizing
- [Best 3D printing service in Barcelona](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/best-3d-printing-service-barcelona) — practical breakdown by use case, honest about when we're not the right fit
- [3D printing pricing (blog)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/blog/precio-impresion-3d-barcelona) — Spanish blog post explaining what drives the price of a 3D print

## For Makers

- [Join the maker network](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/makers) — recruitment page: free to join, no signup fee, no commission, no exclusivity
- [Maker network — how it works](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/maker-guide) — full walkthrough: how orders reach you, quoting, direct customer payment
- [How to make money with a 3D printer](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/how-to-make-money-with-a-3d-printer) — six income paths (local, marketplaces, files, business, repair, networks) with realistic effort per path
- [Is a 3D printing business profitable?](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/is-3d-printing-business-profitable) — real cost breakdown per gram, per hour, worked pricing example
- [How to get 3D printing customers](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/how-to-get-3d-printing-customers) — customer acquisition tactics: Google Business, marketplaces, photography, pricing, response speed
